title: Complete-day Chaikin money-flow state for BTC long or cash
thesis: A positive twenty-complete-day volume-weighted close-location balance may identify accumulation periods in which next-open BTC exposure has better risk-adjusted economics than unconditional buy-and-hold.
mechanism: Aggregate the sealed BTC H1 corpus into complete UTC-day high, low, close and base volume. Compute each day's money-flow multiplier from its close location in the daily range, multiply by daily base volume, and divide the rolling sum of money-flow volume by rolling total base volume. Hold BTC from the next H1 open only when the primary twenty-day CMF is strictly positive; otherwise hold zero-yield cash.
